info.title: FMS core-api
info.description: National Fuel Monitoring System (Zambia) — owner/manager, ERB regulator, admin and partner APIs.

post.summary: Log in with email + password (+ totp_code when MFA is enabled)
Revoke a refresh token (or all of the caller's tokens with all=true)
Start TOTP enrolment; returns secret + otpauth URL

get.summary: Overview KPIs scoped to the caller
Live tank state with days of cover (array)
Sales grouped by hour|day|product|pump (Africa/Lusaka buckets; array)
Commands sent to the station edge gateway (e.g. price updates) and their acknowledgement status

patch.summary: Reconcile a delivery with its paperwork (owner, manager)

put.summary: Set pump prices (validated against ERB cap); queues an edge set_prices command

get.summary: Alerts in scope (default: open only), newest first
ZRA Smart Invoice fiscal receipts, newest first
Server-Sent Events: tank_latest / sales / alert (auth via Bearer header or ?token=)
Stations of a province with stock and prices (array)
Daily sales per province × product (v_province_daily shape)
Price violations, offline stations, variance anomalies, fiscal failures
ERB cap prices currently in force

post.summary: Publish an ERB cap price (erb_national only)

get.summary: ERB caps in force (kind=erb_cap, default) or current station pump prices (kind=station)
